description: This file defines types, functions, and logic for handling OpenAI completions compatibility, including resolving default settings based on provider and endpoint class, and detecting capabilities.

methods.name: isDefaultRouteProvider
methods.description: Checks if the provider matches one of the specified default route IDs.

methods.name: resolveOpenAICompletionsCompatDefaults
methods.description: Resolves default settings for OpenAI completions based on input parameters.

methods.name: resolveOpenAICompletionsCompatDefaultsFromCapabilities
methods.description: Resolves default settings from provider capabilities.

methods.name: detectOpenAICompletionsCompat
methods.description: Detects capabilities and defaults for a given OpenAI completions model.
